text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best today, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Right! I have to focus on rehabilitation
first!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We can't do any serious training while
Nishino Flower is going through
rehabilitation,
but there's still plenty we
can do. If anything, our days are busy.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, <username>!
You look way more cheerful than the last
time I saw you! That's great! We were
worried about you,
you know.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
You seemed pretty depressed, so we were
thinking about taking you
out for a meal
sometime—

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainers
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Wh-what is it?!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
You want our help filling in any gaps you
might have as a trainer? Say no more!
Experience is the best teacher, but there
are also things you can only learn from
your colleagues!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
I trained someone who injured themself
the same way. I still have my
old notes, so
I'll make copies of them for you.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainers
text_block_list.text: You've got this, rookie!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Using advice from my senior trainers,
books I borrowed from the library, and
past notes, I start putting together a
rehabilitation
program.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And while rehabilitation is important,
I'll need to think about what
comes after too.
I'm racking my brain for ideas when I hear
a knock at the door.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Have you had lunch yet, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Actually, lunch started a few minutes
ago. So, um... I made this
for you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping we could eat together, so I
made lunch for both of us.
I'm pretty good
at making meatballs with sweet vinegar
sauce. Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm glad you like it. If there's
anything else you'd like to eat, let
me
know. I'll make it for our next lunch
together. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower's rehabilitation period
ends
in the blink of an eye.
Now, we're ready to
start training in earnest!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
We can finally start training!
I'm ready to
go whenever you are—
Wahey-hey!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Running besties for life! Girl, we run these sprints!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You're so goated for that!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm! Next up is hill sprints, is it?
Easy-peasy! As class rep, I'll
overcome any
wall or incline that comes my way!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone's working so hard! And from
today, I'll be joining them!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Not at all! You designed this program
just for me, and I have faith in
you. So I'm
not going to get ahead of myself by
comparing myself to everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Well, time to get started!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so,
Nishino Flower begins her training.
Gradually, she's able to
run at the pace
she did before her injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I also continue my studies,
so I can be the
trainer she deserves. Then, one day, the
academy announces that it's holding
scrimmages.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A scrimmage... Eurgh. I feel so nervous.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(The last time I ran,
I couldn't keep up, no
matter how hard I tried.
The memory of
that day still stings.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(But... But I've been working really hard
with Trainer. I'm sure I'll do
better this
time—)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You're shaking, Trainer. Are you nervous
too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The shakiness in my voice must be far from
reassuring. But no matter how
nerve-racking the situation may be, my
faith in Nishino Flower is
unshakable.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...!
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Inhale, exhale.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Right! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "I know you can win this!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Trainer's voice was shaking, but I heard those words loud and clear. I can win this. My training will pay off.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer believes in me, so I'll do
everything I can to share my courage
with
them.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
("It's all right.
Everything is going to be all
right." That's what I want
to communicate
through my running.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I want Trainer to be happy.
Just like that
day Mom and Dad smiled
so brightly!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I want to give courage to lots of
people!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Caster
text_block_list.text:
Aaand that's the race!
It's Nishino Flower!
Nishino Flower takes first
place!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I did,
didn't I? Thank you! I... I'll do even
better next time, so—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amid the cheers, Nishino Flower smiles
widely. Her expression
reminds me of that
field of flowers we saw together.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer, you always give everything one
hundred percent. You work

hard—sometimes too hard.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(That's why someday, I want to win first
place in a G1 race. I want to
give you the
gift of a victory.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Thank you, Trainer, for always supporting
my dreams.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Thank you for accepting the courage I
shared with you.)
